description: MSP SSL Chaos Tamer - Parallel Execution Job Queue

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Critical path - must complete before other phases

jobs.name: Set up core project structure and base interfaces
deliverables: Directory structure for certificate management, CA plugins, and MSP integration components
Base interfaces that establish system boundaries and plugin architecture
ReflectiveModule base classes for systematic observability

phases.name: Core Components
phases.description: 4 tasks can run in parallel after Phase 1

jobs.name: Create certificate and MSP data models
deliverables: Certificate, Client, and MSP dataclasses with validation methods
Certificate lifecycle state management
Unit tests for data model validation and state transitions

jobs.name: Implement encrypted credential storage system
deliverables: Secure credential storage using AES-256 encryption
Credential rotation and key management utilities
Unit tests for encryption/decryption and key rotation

jobs.name: Create certificate database schema and operations
deliverables: SQLite database schema for certificate inventory
Database operations with proper indexing and performance optimization
Unit tests for database operations and data integrity

jobs.name: Implement base CA plugin interface
deliverables: Abstract base class for CA plugins with standard interface
Plugin discovery and lifecycle management
Unit tests for plugin loading and interface compliance

phases.name: Plugins & Infrastructure
phases.description: 5 tasks can run in parallel after Phase 2

jobs.name: Create Let's Encrypt ACME plugin
deliverables: ACME protocol client for Let's Encrypt integration
Certificate request, renewal, and revocation workflows
Unit tests using Let's Encrypt staging environment

jobs.name: Implement GoDaddy API plugin
deliverables: GoDaddy REST API client with authentication
Certificate management workflows for GoDaddy
Unit tests using GoDaddy sandbox environment

jobs.name: Create Docker container deployment
deliverables: Dockerfile and docker-compose configuration
Container health checks and monitoring
Deployment scripts and documentation

jobs.name: Write comprehensive deployment documentation
deliverables: Installation guides for all deployment modes (Docker, VM, cloud, bare metal)
Configuration options and MSP-specific setup procedures
Troubleshooting guides and operational procedures

jobs.name: Create Prometheus metrics integration
deliverables: Comprehensive metrics collection for all certificate operations
Custom Prometheus metrics for MSP-specific monitoring
Unit tests for metrics collection and export

phases.name: Core Features
phases.description: 6 tasks can run in parallel after Phase 3

jobs.name: Implement domain certificate scanner
deliverables: Certificate discovery using DNS and HTTPS probing
Certificate chain validation and parsing
Unit tests for certificate discovery and validation

jobs.name: Create certificate inventory management
deliverables: Certificate inventory database operations
Certificate status tracking and health monitoring
Unit tests for inventory management and status updates

jobs.name: Create renewal scheduling engine
deliverables: Predictive renewal timing based on CA-specific delays
Renewal policy management and enforcement
Unit tests for renewal scheduling and policy application

jobs.name: Implement emergency detection and alerting
deliverables: Emergency scenario detection (expired, compromised certificates)
Emergency alerting and escalation workflows
Unit tests for emergency detection and alert generation

jobs.name: Create client portal web application
deliverables: Flask/FastAPI web application with MSP branding support
Client authentication and tenant isolation
Unit tests for web application routes and authentication

jobs.name: Build configuration management system
deliverables: Web-based configuration wizard for initial setup
Configuration validation and environment-specific settings
Unit tests for configuration management and validation

phases.name: Advanced Features
phases.description: 6 tasks can run in parallel after Phase 4

jobs.name: Build renewal execution workflows
deliverables: CA-specific renewal workflows with error handling
Renewal failure detection and retry mechanisms
Unit tests for renewal execution and failure recovery

jobs.name: Create emergency certificate provisioning
deliverables: One-click emergency certificate workflows
Emergency certificate deployment and validation
Unit tests for emergency provisioning and deployment

jobs.name: Implement real-time certificate status dashboard
deliverables: WebSocket-based real-time certificate status updates
Certificate health visualization and alerts
Unit tests for real-time updates and dashboard functionality

jobs.name: Implement ticketing system integrations
deliverables: ConnectWise Manage API integration for ticket creation
Autotask API integration for MSP workflow automation
Unit tests for ticketing system integrations

jobs.name: Create billing and cost tracking system
deliverables: Certificate cost tracking per client
Billing report generation and export functionality
Unit tests for cost tracking and billing calculations

jobs.name: Build health monitoring and alerting
deliverables: ReflectiveModule health endpoints for all components
Structured logging with correlation IDs for troubleshooting
Unit tests for health monitoring and log generation

phases.name: Testing & Security
phases.description: 4 tasks can run in parallel after Phase 5

jobs.name: Implement integration testing framework
deliverables: Integration tests using real CA sandbox environments
MSP workflow testing with mock integrations
Chaos engineering tests for failure scenario validation

jobs.name: Build performance and load testing
deliverables: Load testing for realistic MSP certificate volumes
Performance benchmarks for certificate operations
Stress tests for emergency scenarios and high-load conditions

jobs.name: Create security audit and compliance features
deliverables: Comprehensive audit logging for all certificate operations
Security scanning and vulnerability assessment tools
Unit tests for security features and audit trail validation

jobs.name: Build access control and authentication system
deliverables: Role-based access control (RBAC) for MSP staff
Multi-factor authentication and session management
Unit tests for authentication and authorization workflows

phases.name: Community & Production
phases.description: 4 tasks can run in parallel after Phase 6

jobs.name: Build community contribution framework
deliverables: Developer documentation and contribution guidelines
Plugin development SDK and examples
Documentation for extending and customizing the system

jobs.name: Perform end-to-end system validation
deliverables: Complete MSP workflow testing from discovery to renewal
All CA integrations validated with real certificate operations
Emergency scenarios and recovery procedures tested

jobs.name: Conduct MSP pilot deployment
deliverables: System deployed in real MSP environment for pilot testing
Feedback and performance metrics from actual MSP usage
Final optimizations based on real-world testing

jobs.name: Create additional CA plugins (Namecheap, DigiCert)
deliverables: Namecheap and DigiCert API plugins
Certificate management workflows for additional CAs
Unit tests for new CA integrations
